scenarios.title: Visit triggers only when the roll equals a lit-up number

setup.notes: Concession Stand is the printing variant whose lit-up numbers are 2 and 6. It has been on A's battlefield since a previous turn. Roll results are fixed by the scenario.

decisions: At the beginning of A's precombat main phase, A rolls to visit their Attractions. The d6 shows 2.
Both players pass priority until the stack is empty.

variants.label: roll_two
variants.expected: The roll equals a lit-up number, so the visit ability triggers and resolves. A creates a Food token (A controls Concession Stand and a Food token).

variants.label: roll_six
variants.expected: 6 is lit up: the visit ability triggers and A creates a Food token.

variants.label: roll_four
variants.expected: 4 is not a lit-up number. The visit ability does not trigger. A creates no Food token.

scenarios.forge_notes: Reaching this state needs an Attraction on the battlefield, which in Forge needs an attraction deck and the lit-up variant; the die result must be forced.
